question: What carbon and nitrogen contents did XPS give for the (Pd/Cu)0.5%C3N4 photocatalyst used for photocatalytic ozonation?
rendered:
According to Table 2, XPS analysis gave the following elemental composition for the (Pd/Cu)0.5%C3N4 photocatalyst:

C [at. %]: 6.86
N [at. %]: 43.83
